plan.title: Verify environment and package versions
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Install/pin ultralytics==8.1.0 if needed. Confirm GPU availability and VRAM.
plan.success_criteria: All critical packages at correct versions, GPU confirmed with VRAM reported

plan.title: Explore dataset structure and annotations
plan.description: Load data/train/annotations.json, count images, annotations, categories. Compute stats: annotations per image (min/max/mean), category frequency distribution, image dimensions. Examine data/products/ structure (how many products have reference images, how many images per product). Load metadata.json and understand its schema.
plan.success_criteria: Full understanding of data properties: 248 images, ~22700 annotations, 357 categories, image sizes, reference image availability per category

plan.title: Understand annotation details and store sections
plan.description: Examine annotation fields (bbox format, area, corrected flag, iscrowd). Identify the 4 store sections from image filenames or metadata. Check category_id distribution — which categories are rare (1-2 instances) vs common. Check if category 356 (unknown_product) is heavily used.
plan.success_criteria: Know store sections per image, category frequency histogram, corrected annotation ratio, bbox size distribution

plan.title: Create stratified 90/10 train/val split
plan.description: Write a script to split 248 images into ~223 train / ~25 val, stratified by store section, seed=42. Output train_split.json and val_split.json in COCO format. Verify both files are valid COCO format with correct image/annotation/category counts.
plan.success_criteria: Two valid COCO JSON files, proportional store section representation in val, all annotations for an image stay together

plan.title: Write evaluation function
plan.description: Implement eval function using pycocotools COCOeval. Compute detection_mAP@0.5 (all predictions mapped to single category) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original category_ids). Combine as val_score = 0.7 * det_mAP + 0.3 * cls_mAP. Test with dummy predictions to verify it works.
plan.success_criteria: Function returns correct val_score, tested with synthetic predictions

plan.title: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format
plan.description: Write converter from COCO JSON to YOLO txt format (one txt per image with class x_center y_center width height normalized). Create dataset YAML for ultralytics. Handle the 357 categories correctly.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO-format labels directory and dataset.yaml created, spot-checked for correctness

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8n nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8n baseline with 357 classes at 640px achieves val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n on train split with nc=357, imgsz=640, 100 epochs, batch=16. Run inference on val split, evaluate with the eval function. This establishes the floor.
plan.success_criteria: val_score computed and logged as baseline reference

plan.title: YOLOv8s nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s improves over YOLOv8n by at least 0.05 val_score
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s with same settings as baseline. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over YOLOv8n logged

plan.title: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m further improves val_score over YOLOv8s
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m, 100 epochs, imgsz=640. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to previous best

plan.title: YOLOv8l nc=357 at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Larger model + higher resolution significantly improves detection on dense shelves
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l with imgsz=1280, batch=4-8 (adjust for GPU memory), 150 epochs. The higher resolution should help detect small products.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over 640px models

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x at 1280 is the best single YOLO model for this task
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with imgsz=1280, batch=4, 200 epochs, close_mosaic=50. This is expected to be the strongest single detector.
plan.success_criteria: Highest val_score among single YOLO models

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 (detection only) at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection mAP than nc=357 since it doesn't need to classify
plan.description: Convert all annotations to category 0. Train YOLOv8x nc=1, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. This model will be used as the detection backbone for the two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 higher than nc=357 model's detection_mAP

plan.title: Explore DINOv2 embeddings for classification
plan.description: Load DINOv2-base (from torch.hub or timm). Extract embeddings for: (a) cropped training annotations, (b) reference product images from data/products/. Measure embedding dimensionality, compute pairwise similarities for same-category vs different-category pairs. Visualize with t-SNE on a subset.
plan.success_criteria: Understand embedding quality: same-category similarity vs cross-category, identify if DINOv2 can distinguish visually similar products

plan.title: Build DINOv2 gallery from reference images + training crops
plan.description: For each of 357 categories, collect embeddings from: reference product images (data/products/) and training annotation crops. Store as a gallery (category_id → list of embeddings). Implement kNN lookup function that takes a query crop embedding and returns predicted category_id.
plan.success_criteria: Gallery built with embeddings for all available categories, kNN function working

plan.title: Two-stage baseline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2-base kNN
plan.hypothesis: Two-stage approach (nc=1 detector + DINOv2 classifier) achieves higher val_score than nc=357 YOLO alone
plan.description: Use nc=1 YOLO detections on val split. For each detection, crop from original image, extract DINOv2-base embedding, kNN lookup (k=5) against gallery. Evaluate full val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score higher than best nc=357 YOLO model

plan.title: Tune kNN parameters for DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k and distance weighting improve classification mAP by 1-3 points
plan.description: Sweep k={1,3,5,7,11}, distance metrics (cosine, L2), temperature for softmax weighting, on val split using ground truth boxes. Find optimal kNN config.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN config identified, classification mAP improvement quantified

plan.title: Gallery composition experiment
plan.hypothesis: Optimal weighting of reference images vs training crops improves classification
plan.description: Test gallery variants: (a) reference images only, (b) training crops only, (c) mixed with different weightings (1:1, 1:2, 2:1 reference:crop). Evaluate classification mAP on val split using GT boxes.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base for classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large produces significantly better embeddings for fine-grained product distinction
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large, rebuild gallery, evaluate classification mAP on val split with GT boxes. Compare to DINOv2-base. Check model size for budget feasibility.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP comparison logged, model size noted for budget planning

plan.title: NMS and score threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS IoU threshold and confidence threshold improves detection mAP on dense shelves
plan.description: Using best YOLO model, sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8} and confidence threshold {0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3} on val split. Find optimal combination.
plan.success_criteria: Best NMS/conf thresholds identified, val_score improvement quantified

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA improves detection mAP by 1-2 points
plan.description: Run best YOLO model with augment=True on val split. Compare detection_mAP and val_score to non-TTA. Measure inference time increase.
plan.success_criteria: TTA impact on val_score and inference time quantified

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference significantly improves detection of small products, boosting detection mAP by 3-5 points
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice each image into overlapping 1280×1280 tiles (stride 960), run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge with WBF. Evaluate on val split. Measure inference time.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improvement quantified, inference time within 300s budget for ~50 test images

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO classes vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification mAP
plan.description: For each detection, compare YOLO class confidence vs DINOv2 embedding similarity. Implement gating: if YOLO conf > threshold, use YOLO class; else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep threshold on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Gated approach outperforms either method alone on classification mAP

plan.title: Train RT-DETR-l at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l achieves competitive val_score and provides diversity for ensemble
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l (available in ultralytics 8.1.0) with nc=357, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs. Evaluate standalone val_score. Note: transformer-based, different error profile from YOLO.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l val_score logged, compared to best YOLO

plan.title: RT-DETR-l nc=1 for detection
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l nc=1 provides complementary detections to YOLO nc=1
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=1, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs. Compare detection_mAP to YOLO nc=1. Analyze where each model makes different errors.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP logged, error analysis showing complementary strengths

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLO + RT-DETR
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO and RT-DETR with WBF improves detection mAP by 2-4 points over best single model
plan.description: Combine predictions from YOLOv8x and RT-DETR-l using Weighted Boxes Fusion. Tune WBF parameters (iou_thr, skip_box_thr, weights) on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: Multi-scale ensemble: same model at different resolutions
plan.hypothesis: Running YOLO at 640 and 1280 and merging catches products at different scales
plan.description: Run best YOLO at imgsz=640 and imgsz=1280, merge with WBF. Compare to single-resolution. This is cheap (no retraining) and may catch large products better at 640.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over single resolution

plan.title: Fine-tune DINOv2 projection head with ArcFace loss
plan.hypothesis: A learned projection head on frozen DINOv2 improves classification mAP by 2-5 points
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, add 2-layer MLP projection head. Train with ArcFace loss on training crops + reference images. The projection head learns to separate visually similar products. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement over raw DINOv2 kNN

plan.title: Multi-crop DINOv2 inference
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations improves classification robustness
plan.description: For each detection, extract 4 crop variants: original, center-zoomed (80%), padded (120%), and horizontally flipped. Average embeddings before kNN lookup. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement over single-crop

plan.title: YOLOv8x training with longer epochs and tuned hyperparameters
plan.hypothesis: Training for 400+ epochs with close_mosaic=100 and label_smoothing=0.1 improves val_score
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at 1280px for 400 epochs with close_mosaic=100, label_smoothing=0.1, patience=100. Compare to 200-epoch baseline.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over shorter training

plan.title: Progressive resizing training
plan.hypothesis: Training at 640 for 100 epochs then 1280 for 300 epochs is faster and potentially better than 1280 throughout
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x: first 100 epochs at 640 (fast convergence), then resume at 1280 for 300 epochs (fine detail). Compare val_score and total training time to constant 1280.
plan.success_criteria: Comparable or better val_score with reduced training time

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Synthetic augmentation with reference product images improves rare category detection
plan.description: Implement copy-paste: for rare categories (<5 instances), paste reference product images onto shelf backgrounds with perspective warps and lighting adjustments. Retrain YOLOv8x with augmented data.
plan.success_criteria: Improved classification mAP for rare categories, overall val_score improvement

plan.title: Class-balanced sampling / focal loss for rare categories
plan.hypothesis: Oversampling images with rare categories improves classification of those categories
plan.description: Implement image-level oversampling: images containing rare categories (< 5 instances total) are duplicated 3-5x in training. Alternatively, increase focal loss gamma. Retrain and evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement, especially for rare categories

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Giving higher weight to corrected annotations improves model quality
plan.description: Identify annotations with corrected=True. Duplicate these in training data (effectively 2x weight). Retrain YOLOv8x and evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from cleaner training signal

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Using shelf section context improves classification accuracy
plan.description: Build category co-occurrence matrix from training data. At inference, identify likely store section from initial detections, then apply Bayesian prior to adjust classification probabilities. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement from contextual priors

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Matching individual patch tokens instead of global embedding improves classification for occluded products
plan.description: Extract patch-level tokens from DINOv2 for query crops and gallery entries. Implement patch-level matching (e.g., average of top-k patch similarities). Compare to global embedding kNN.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement, especially for partially occluded products

plan.title: Per-category adaptive confidence thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Category-specific thresholds improve classification by avoiding confident wrong predictions
plan.description: For each category, learn an optimal confidence threshold from val split. Categories where DINOv2 is unreliable get higher thresholds (fall back to category_id=0). Implement and evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from adaptive thresholds

plan.title: ONNX export and inference speed benchmark
plan.hypothesis: ONNX inference is fast enough for tiled inference + DINOv2 within 300s
plan.description: Export best YOLO model to ONNX FP16. Export DINOv2 to ONNX FP16. Benchmark inference time on val split with full pipeline (tiling + detection + crop + classify). Verify fits in 300s for ~50 test images on L4 GPU.
plan.success_criteria: Full pipeline inference time < 300s, model sizes fit in 420 MB

plan.title: INT8 quantization of YOLO
plan.hypothesis: INT8 YOLO loses < 0.5 mAP but saves ~50% model size
plan.description: Quantize best YOLO to INT8 via ONNX post-training quantization. Evaluate detection_mAP loss. If acceptable, this frees budget for DINOv2-large.
plan.success_criteria: INT8 model size and mAP loss quantified

plan.title: Optimal model combination for 420MB budget
plan.hypothesis: The best val_score comes from the right combination of detector + classifier within size constraints
plan.description: Based on all previous experiments, enumerate feasible model combinations that fit in 420MB. Test top 3-4 combinations on val split. Consider: (a) YOLOv8x FP16 + DINOv2-base FP16, (b) YOLOv8l FP16 + DINOv2-large FP16, (c) YOLOv8x INT8 + DINOv2-large FP16, (d) YOLO+RTDETR ensemble + DINOv2-base.
plan.success_criteria: Best feasible combination identified with highest val_score

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling at test time
plan.hypothesis: Adding high-confidence test-time crops to the gallery improves classification of repeated products
plan.description: Implement two-pass inference: first pass detects and classifies all test images. Second pass adds high-confidence crops (score > 0.85) to DINOv2 gallery, then re-classifies uncertain detections. Products appearing multiple times get better gallery coverage.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from pseudo-labeling (simulate on val split)

plan.title: Image preprocessing: CLAHE and white balance
plan.hypothesis: Contrast enhancement helps detection on poorly lit shelf images
plan.description: Apply CLAHE and/or white balance correction to val images before detection. Compare detection_mAP with and without preprocessing.
plan.success_criteria: Determine if preprocessing helps or hurts

plan.title: Rectangular inference mode
plan.hypothesis: rect=True preserves aspect ratio better and improves detection on non-square images
plan.description: Run YOLO inference with rect=True on val split. Compare detection_mAP to square resize.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison logged

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x at 1600px resolution
plan.hypothesis: Training at 1600px captures more product detail than 1280px
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at imgsz=1600, batch=2 with gradient accumulation. May need to reduce other settings. Compare val_score to 1280px training.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison, training feasibility confirmed

plan.title: Smaller YOLO + more tiles tradeoff
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m with more/smaller tiles beats YOLOv8x with fewer tiles within the same time budget
plan.description: Compare: (a) YOLOv8x on 4 tiles per image vs (b) YOLOv8m on 9 tiles per image. Same total inference time budget. Evaluate detection_mAP.
plan.success_criteria: Determine optimal model-size vs tile-count tradeoff

plan.title: Soft-NMS vs WBF for single model
plan.hypothesis: Soft-NMS is better than hard NMS for single-model dense shelf detection
plan.description: Implement Soft-NMS (Gaussian and linear variants) for single model predictions. Compare to hard NMS and WBF on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Best post-processing method identified for single model

plan.title: Embedding-weighted box fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using DINOv2 embedding agreement as additional signal during box fusion improves both detection and classification
plan.description: When merging overlapping boxes from ensemble, compute DINOv2 embedding similarity between the crops. Weight boxes higher when their embeddings agree. Implement and evaluate.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over standard WBF

plan.title: Train with mixup and mosaic variations
plan.hypothesis: Different augmentation strategies affect dense detection differently
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with different augmentation configs: (a) heavy mosaic + mixup, (b) mosaic only, (c) minimal augmentation with early close_mosaic. Compare val_scores.
plan.success_criteria: Best augmentation config identified

plan.title: Supervised contrastive learning on DINOv2 features
plan.hypothesis: SupCon loss produces better-separated embeddings than ArcFace for this product set
plan.description: Train projection head with supervised contrastive loss instead of ArcFace. Compare classification mAP on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Compare SupCon vs ArcFace projection heads

plan.title: Build complete inference pipeline
plan.description: Assemble the best components into a complete run.py: tiled inference (if beneficial), best detector, best classifier (DINOv2 with optimal gallery and kNN), confidence gating, optimal NMS/thresholds. Test end-to-end on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Complete pipeline achieves best val_score, runs within time/size constraints

plan.title: Final val_score verification and ablation
plan.hypothesis: Each component contributes positively to the final val_score
plan.description: Run ablation study: remove each component one at a time (tiling, TTA, ensemble, DINOv2, confidence gating, etc.) and measure val_score drop. Confirm every component is net positive.
plan.success_criteria: All components justified, final val_score is the highest achieved

plan.title: Optimize inference speed
plan.description: Profile the full pipeline. Identify bottlenecks. Optimize: batch DINOv2 crops, use ONNX runtime, reduce unnecessary computation. Ensure total inference time < 300s on L4 for expected test set size.
plan.success_criteria: Inference time < 300s with minimal val_score loss

plan.title: Package final submission
plan.description: Create submission.zip with run.py, model weights (.pt or .onnx), gallery files, helper scripts. Verify: total size < 420MB, no blocked imports, correct output format. Test run.py with --input and --output args.
plan.success_criteria: Valid submission zip, passes all format checks

plan.title: Sanity check: run submission pipeline on val split
plan.hypothesis: Packaged submission reproduces the best val_score
plan.description: Run the packaged run.py on val images, evaluate output predictions.json with eval function. Confirm val_score matches expectations.
plan.success_criteria: val_score from packaged submission matches best recorded val_score

plan.title: Document best configuration
plan.description: Write a summary of the best configuration: model architecture, training hyperparameters, inference pipeline details, val_score breakdown (detection_mAP, classification_mAP). This is for the human operator to retrain on full data.
plan.success_criteria: Clear documentation of best config for full-data retraining
